personality: 5 Brutalist Mobile (customized for high-end luxury fashion)
personality_one_liner: A stark, architectural canvas of pure black and white that elevates clothing photography to an editorial standard, inspired by SSENSE and Farfetch.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grids, edge-to-edge sections, and exposed structure. Strict flush alignments. Empty space is architectural, not accidental padding.

dont's: No glassmorphism, blur, or translucency. Use solid colors and 1pt hairline borders to separate stacked elements.

screens.name: Closet
screens.purpose: A highly structured, grid-based digital wardrobe where users view and filter their uploaded clothing items.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner with 'SYNCING CLOSET...' in uppercase mono.
states.empty: Stark empty view. Text: 'WARDROBE EMPTY'. Primary square button: 'UPLOAD ITEM'.

screens.layout: Sticky top bar with sharp rectangular filter chips (horizontal scroll). Below: flush 2-column or 3-column grid of items with 1pt hairline borders separating cells. Images use transparent backgrounds (auto-background removal). Square FAB (0px radius) in bottom right for adding items.

screens.name: AI Stylist Chat
screens.purpose: Conversational interface for generating outfits and receiving styling advice.

states.empty: List of sharp-edged quick prompt chips (e.g., 'Date night', 'Office casual').

screens.layout: Messages are NOT rounded bubbles, but full-width sections or sharp-edged blocks. Outfit composite result cards display a collage of transparent clothing items, a 'Stylist Note' in Satoshi, and action buttons ('SAVE OUTFIT', 'TRY ANOTHER'). Bottom prompt bar is edge-to-edge with a 1pt top border, no radius. Allow item attachment into prompt context.

screens.name: Saved Outfits
screens.purpose: An editorial lookbook of the user's favorite generated or curated outfits.

states.loading: Skeleton of large full-width image blocks.
states.error: Text: 'COULD NOT LOAD LOOKBOOK'. Retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical feed of full-width, edge-to-edge outfit composite cards. Each card acts like a fashion magazine page: large imagery, stark typography for the title, and a list of included items below. Heavy use of whitespace and hairline dividers between posts.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User settings, style preferences, and wardrobe analytics.
screens.layout: List of edge-to-edge rows with 1pt bottom borders. Sections for 'DRESS CODE DEFAULTS', 'WEATHER CONTEXT', 'COLOR PALETTE'. Avatar is a sharp square, not a circle. Minimalist typography for labels.

boots_transparent.alt: High fashion black leather boots featuring chunky soles

outfit_composite_hero.alt: A person in a blazer and trousers with a hand in a pocket - smart casual outfit

profile_avatar.alt: A focused portrait of a young man

instructions_to_main_agent: Adopt a rigid 0px border-radius across the entire application to mimic high-end fashion platforms like SSENSE and Farfetch.
Use 1pt hairline borders (using the 'border' token) extensively to separate UI elements, grid items, and rows, replacing traditional spacing and drop shadows.
The color palette must enforce strict monochrome (pure black and white) for all branding, navigation, and primary interactive elements.
Do NOT use glassmorphism, blurs, or rounded floating elements. Rely on solid color blocking and borders.
In the AI Stylist Chat, design outfit composite cards like editorial spreads rather than standard message bubbles. Feature transparent clothing PNGs grouped elegantly.
For Dark Mode, ensure elements remain stark. Surface is pure #000000, with 1pt borders in #2a2a2a, ensuring a complete inversion that maintains the high-contrast Brutalist aesthetic.
For the Closet Grid, remove padding between grid cells and use borders to define the grid, maximizing the canvas for the transparent clothing images.
